title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: 学习解读扩散变换器中的上下文令牌

paragraphs.en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiTs）在整个生成过程中联合处理视觉和文本表示。 这些模型通过多模态注意力机制反复更新文本词元，形成动态的上下文词元，但其具体功能尚不明确。 在本研究中，我们提出了一种框架，通过自然语言提问来解读这一上下文空间。 我们训练了一个轻量级的瓶颈网络，将中间上下文词元映射到冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）的输入空间中，使 LLM 能够直接根据这些隐藏表示回答关于生成图像的问题。 我们的“阅读器”揭示出，上下文词元编码了生成场景的丰富全局表示：与特定生成过程相关的语义信息（包括提示中未明确指定的属性）在去噪阶段早期即可被识别，而更精细的细节则随着时间推移逐渐变得清晰。 值得注意的是，即使 MM-DiT 接收到空提示时，这些信息仍然可以被解码，这表明上下文词元能够从不断演变的视觉表示本身中积累大量与图像相关的特定信息。 我们进一步发现，具有更高可读性上下文表示的生成结果往往能获得更高的人类偏好评分。 基于这些观察，我们提出了“上下文对齐”（Contextual Alignment）这一训练技术，它明确强化上下文词元中所编码的视觉-语义信息，从而提升生成质量和分布覆盖范围。 综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，上下文词元既是理解 MM-DiTs 内部动态过程的一种可解释视角，也是改进生成模型的有效目标。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, diffusion models have fundamentally transformed visual content creation by enabling high-fidelity generation directly from text prompts ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ) . Building on this foundation, Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have emerged as a dominant paradigm for state-of-the-art image and video synthesis ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ) . Central to these models are multimodal attention layers, which enable bidirectional interaction between textual and visual representations throughout generation.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，扩散模型通过直接从文本提示生成高保真内容，彻底改变了视觉内容创作（Rombach 等，2022；Saharia 等，2022；Ramesh 等，2022）。 在此基础上，多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiTs）已成为当前最先进的图像和视频合成的主流范式（Esser 等，2024；Kong 等，2024；Chefer 等，2026）。 这些模型的核心是多模态注意力层，它使得文本和视觉表示在整个生成过程中能够进行双向交互。

paragraphs.en: Within this shared multimodal space, visual tokens form a spatial representation of the evolving image and are explicitly supervised by the denoising objective. Their intermediate features can therefore be directly visualized as images ( Patashnik et al., 2023 ; Tumanyan et al., 2023 ) , making them especially accessible to analysis and intervention. This has enabled methods that guide visual features for controlled generation ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Chefer et al., 2023 ) , manipulate them for image editing ( Meng et al., 2021 ; Avrahami et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2022 ) , and align them with pretrained representations to improve generation ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Leng et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在这个共享的多模态空间中，视觉标记构成了演化图像的空间表示，并受到去噪目标的明确监督。 因此，它们的中间特征可以直接以图像形式可视化（Patashnik 等人，2023；Tumanyan 等人，2023），这使得它们特别便于分析和干预。 这已经催生了多种方法：引导视觉特征以实现受控生成（Ho 和 Salimans，2022；Zhang 等人，2023；Chefer 等人，2023）；对它们进行操控以实现图像编辑（Meng 等人，2021；Avrahami 等人，2022；Hertz 等人，2022）；以及将它们与预训练表示对齐以改进生成效果（Yu 等人，2024；Leng 等人，2025；Jiang 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: The text stream, however, is considerably less understood. In modern MM-DiTs, text tokens do not remain fixed conditioning vectors. Instead, they are repeatedly updated through multimodal attention, absorbing information from the emerging visual representation and evolving into what prior work termed contextual tokens ( Dahary et al., 2026 ) . Although this cross-modal exchange has proven effective for generation ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , the function of the resulting contextual representations remains unclear. Unlike visual tokens, contextual tokens have no explicit spatial correspondence and receive no dedicated supervision, making them inherently difficult to interpret. Consequently, it remains unknown what visual information they encode and how their dynamics ultimately steer the generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，文本流的理解程度却低得多。 在现代 MM-DiTs 中，文本标记并非固定的条件向量。 相反，它们通过多模态注意力机制被反复更新，吸收来自新生成的视觉表征的信息，并演变为先前的研究所称的上下文标记（Dahary et al., 2026）。 尽管这种跨模态交互已被证明对生成过程有效（Esser et al., 2024），但由此产生的上下文表征的具体功能仍不清楚。 与视觉标记不同，上下文标记没有明确的空间对应关系，也没有专门的监督机制，因此本质上难以解释。 因此，它们编码了哪些视觉信息，以及其动态变化最终如何引导生成过程，仍然未知。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose a framework to directly read and interpret the contextual space of MM-DiTs by enabling natural language interrogation of their hidden representations. Rather than inspecting raw attention maps or feature vectors, our approach enables asking plain-text questions about visual elements in the emerging image and receiving direct answers decoded straight from the contextual tokens. To achieve this, we train a lightweight bottleneck network that projects intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a Large Language Model (LLM). Because the LLM relies exclusively on the projected contextual tokens to answer visual questions, the bottleneck learns to extract the model’s internal visual semantics directly from the text-side representation. In doing so, we can read the model’s evolving generative intent in plain text, revealing how it internally resolves underspecified prompt attributes over the course of generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种框架，通过允许对 MM-DiTs 的隐藏表示进行自然语言查询，从而直接读取和解释其上下文空间。 与检查原始的注意力图或特征向量不同，我们的方法使得用户能够以纯文本形式询问生成图像中的视觉元素，并直接从上下文令牌中解码出答案。 为实现这一点，我们训练了一个轻量级的瓶颈网络，将中间上下文令牌投影到大语言模型（LLM）的输入空间中。 由于 LLM 完全依赖投影后的上下文令牌来回答视觉问题，因此该瓶颈网络学会了直接从文本侧的表示中提取模型的内部视觉语义。 通过这种方式，我们可以以纯文本形式读取模型不断演变的生成意图，揭示其在生成过程中如何内部解决提示词中未明确指定的属性。

paragraphs.en: Through our reading mechanism, we find that contextual tokens encode generation-specific semantics surprisingly early in denoising. Remarkably, this remains true even when no prompt is fed into the model, showing that the tokens can acquire substantial information from the evolving visual representation alone. Figure 1 demonstrates this setting: despite the MM-DiT receiving an empty prompt, the reader can identify the person’s activity at an early denoising stage, before it can be readily inferred from the visual prediction. Moreover, we find that readability continues to increase over the course of denoising, with the reader recovering progressively finer details about the emerging image. Importantly, this readability can also vary across different generations from the same prompt. Generations with clearer contextual representations tend to achieve higher human-preference scores, making contextual readability a meaningful signal of generation quality.

paragraphs.en: Building on these observations, we transition from passively reading the contextual tokens to actively supervising them during model training. To this end, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a regularization objective that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual space. We evaluate our supervised training framework through quantitative and qualitative experiments spanning both full model training and fine-tuning. Our experiments show that contextual supervision complements existing alignment methods, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Furthermore, while existing alignment methods provide only limited additional gains in the fine-tuning regime, contextual supervision remains highly effective when adapting an already extensively trained model to a specific dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些观察，我们从被动读取上下文标记转向在模型训练过程中主动监督它们。 为此，我们提出了“上下文对齐”这一正则化目标，它明确强化了上下文空间中编码的视觉-语义信息。 我们通过定量和定性实验对我们的监督训练框架进行了评估，实验涵盖了完整模型训练和微调两种场景。 我们的实验表明，上下文监督能够补充现有的对齐方法，从而提升生成质量和分布覆盖范围。 此外，尽管现有对齐方法在微调阶段仅能带来有限的额外增益，但在将已经充分训练的模型适配到特定数据集时，上下文监督仍然非常有效。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our work establishes the contextual space as a semantically rich representation that can both expose the internal dynamics of multimodal generation and provide an effective target for improving generative models beyond the standard diffusion objective.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究将上下文空间确立为一种语义丰富的表示形式，它既能揭示多模态生成的内部动态，也能为提升生成模型提供有效的目标，从而超越标准的扩散目标。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have traditionally relied on convolutional U-Net architectures as their denoising backbone ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2023 ) . Transformer-based denoisers later offered a more scalable alternative ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , leading to increasingly large transformer-based text-to-image models ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024a ) . Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) took this development further by introducing the Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT), in which textual and visual representations jointly participate in attention and continuously update one another. This bidirectional interaction has since become a prominent design in large-scale image generation and editing models, including FLUX ( Labs, 2024 ; Labs et al., 2025 ) , Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and others ( Zhuo et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work has investigated the internal representations learned by diffusion models. Studies of visual features have shown that intermediate representations encode the semantics of individual patches and the correspondence between them, enabling a range of downstream applications ( Tumanyan et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Patashnik et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Alaluf et al., 2024 ; Dahary et al., 2024 ; Dahary et al., 2025 ; Sella et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究开始探索扩散模型所学习的内部表示。 对视觉特征的研究表明，中间层表示能够编码单个图像块的含义以及它们之间的对应关系，从而支持一系列下游应用（Tumanyan 等，2023；Tang 等，2023；Patashnik 等，2023；Cao 等，2023；Alaluf 等，2024；Dahary 等，2024；Dahary 等，2025；Sella 等，2025；Luo 等，2024）。 其他研究则关注文本到图像模型中的文本表示，探讨语义信息如何在文本词元中被编码和分布（Rassin 等，2022；Toker 等，2024；Kaplan 等，2026；Zhuang 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: With the emergence of MM-DiTs, recent work has also begun to examine the evolving text-side representations formed through multimodal attention. ConceptAttention ( Helbling et al., 2025 ) uses these representations to localize concepts in the generated image, while Contextual Repulsion ( Dahary et al., 2026 ) demonstrates their utility as an intervention space for increasing generation diversity. Several works use causal interventions to reveal functional roles of contextual tokens under specific conditioning settings. Padding Tone ( Toker et al., 2025 ) shows that, under textual conditioning, contextualized padding tokens can contribute additional visual information to the generated image; Vision-Language Binding ( Ge et al., 2026 ) shows that contextual tokens can acquire semantic information from a reference image in FLUX.2 editing; Li et al. ( Li et al., 2026 ) show that LLM-encoded template tokens in Qwen-Image can act as implicit registers for maintaining object identity. Altogether, these interventions demonstrate that contextual tokens can carry information relevant to generation. However, they do not directly reveal the semantic content of the contextual space or how it evolves over denoising. We instead decode this space into natural language, revealing a surprisingly broad range of image-specific semantics encoded within it. Remarkably, this information can be decoded in the absence of textual conditioning and even before it becomes readily apparent in the visual prediction itself.
paragraphs.zh: 随着 MM-DiTs 的出现，近期的研究也开始探索通过多模态注意力形成的、不断演变的文本侧表示。 ConceptAttention（Helbling 等人，2025）利用这些表示来定位生成图像中的概念，而 Contextual Repulsion（Dahary 等人，2026）则证明了它们作为提升生成多样性的干预空间的价值。 多项研究采用因果干预方法，揭示了上下文标记在特定条件设置下的功能角色。 Padding Tone（Toker 等人，2025）表明，在文本条件下，经过上下文化处理的填充标记可以为生成的图像提供额外的视觉信息；Vision-Language Binding（Ge 等人，2026）则显示，在 FLUX.2 编辑中，上下文标记可以从参考图像中获取语义信息；Li 等人 （Li 等人，2026）指出，Qwen-Image 中由 LLM 编码的模板标记可以充当隐式寄存器，用于维持物体身份。 综合来看，这些干预方法表明上下文标记可以携带与生成相关的信息。 然而，它们并未直接揭示上下文空间的语义内容，也未说明该空间在去噪过程中如何演变。 我们转而将该空间解码为自然语言，结果发现其中编码了范围广泛且令人惊讶的图像特定语义信息。 值得注意的是，即便在没有文本条件的情况下，甚至在该信息尚未在视觉预测中清晰显现之前，这些信息仍然可以被解码出来。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has shown that explicitly encouraging diffusion models to learn stronger internal representations can substantially improve both training efficiency and generation quality. REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) introduced this direction by aligning intermediate visual features with representations from a pretrained vision encoder. Subsequent works extend alignment to attention features ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , the latent space ( Leng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , representations derived from the diffusion model itself ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ) , and text–image contrastive objectives ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Recent analyses have also examined the role of local and global information in representation alignment. iREPA ( Singh et al., 2025 ) shows that, for spatial visual features, alignment benefits primarily from preserving and enhancing spatial structure rather than global semantics. REG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) instead shows that global semantic information can benefit class-conditional generation when represented separately through a high-level semantic token alongside the image latents.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究表明，明确鼓励扩散模型学习更强大的内部表示，可以显著提升训练效率和生成质量。 REPA（Yu et al., 2024）通过将中间视觉特征与预训练视觉编码器的表示进行对齐，引入了这一方向。 后续研究将这种对齐扩展到注意力特征（Wang et al., 2026c）、潜在空间（Leng et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2026）、从扩散模型本身派生的表示（Jiang et al., 2025；Chefer et al., 2026），以及文本–图像对比目标（Lee et al., 2026）。 近期的分析还研究了局部和全局信息在表示对齐中的作用。iREPA（Singh et al., 2025）表明，对于空间视觉特征而言，对齐主要受益于空间结构的保留与增强，而非全局语义。 相比之下，REG（Wu et al., 2026）表明，当通过高层语义标记与图像潜在变量分开表示时，全局语义信息可以有益于条件类别生成。

paragraphs.en: We extend these insights to text-conditioned generation and find that global visual semantics are implicitly encoded in the contextual tokens. We therefore align them with a global semantic representation, complementing the local, spatial representations reinforced by existing alignment methods.

paragraphs.en: We introduce the Contextual Reader , a framework for decoding the internal contextual representations of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) into natural language. We formulate this as a visual question answering task. At a selected timestep during generation, the reader receives the contextual representations produced by all MM-DiT layers together with a question about the emerging image. The question can probe the image at different levels of detail, including properties that are not explicitly specified by the prompt. The reader then generates a textual answer using the contextual representation and the question. This allows us to examine which visual semantics are encoded in the contextual space as generation progresses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“情境阅读器”（Contextual Reader），这是一个将多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiTs）的内部情境表示解码为自然语言的框架。 我们将此问题表述为一个视觉问答任务。 在生成过程中选定的某个时间步，阅读器会接收所有 MM-DiT 层产生的情境表示，以及一个关于正在生成的图像的提问。 该问题可以从不同细节层次对图像进行探究，包括提示中未明确说明的属性。 随后，阅读器利用情境表示和问题生成文本答案。 这使我们能够考察在生成过程中，哪些视觉语义被编码到了情境空间中。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates the architecture and training procedure of our Contextual Reader. The reader has two main components. First, a Bottleneck Network aggregates contextual tokens from multiple MM-DiT layers into a small set of tokens, which we call the Contextual Descriptor . Second, a frozen LLM receives this descriptor together with the visual question and generates the final answer.

sents.zh: 首先，一个瓶颈网络将来自多个 MM-DiT 层的上下文标记聚合为一小组标记，我们称之为上下文描述符。

sents.en: Second, a frozen LLM receives this descriptor together with the visual question and generates the final answer.
sents.zh: 其次，一个冻结的 LLM 接收该描述符以及视觉问题，并生成最终答案。

paragraphs.en: At diffusion timestep t t , each block l l produces a sequence of contextual tokens c ( l ) ​ ( t ) ∈ ℝ M × d c^{(l)}(t)\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} , where M M is the text sequence length, including padding tokens, and d d is the model hidden dimension. We aggregate the contextual tokens from all L L transformer blocks. To retain information about where and when each representation was extracted, we augment each sequence with learnable embeddings of its layer and timestep. We then concatenate these augmented tokens along the sequence dimension to form C ⁡ ( t ) ∈ ℝ L ​ M × d C(t)\in\mathbb{R}^{LM\times d} . For full details on the feature extraction, see Appendix A.1.1 .

paragraphs.en: Our language interface is inspired by LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , which connects an external representation to a language model for visual question answering through a learned projection. We adopt a similar interface for the contextual space. We use a lightweight Bottleneck Network to compress C ⁡ ( t ) C(t) into a small set of tokens. The bottleneck consists of a 2-layer Q-Former with Q Q learnable query tokens, where Q ≪ L ⋅ M Q\ll L\cdot M , followed by a linear projection into the input embedding space of the frozen LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的语言接口受 LLaVA（Liu 等人，2023）启发，该模型通过一种学习到的投影，将外部表示与语言模型连接起来，以实现视觉问答。 我们对上下文空间也采用了类似的接口。 我们使用一个轻量级的瓶颈网络，将 C⁡(t) 压缩为一小组标记。 该瓶颈由一个包含 2 层 Q-Former 的网络组成，其中 Q 为可学习的查询标记，且 Q ≪ L ⋅ M；随后通过线性投影将其映射到冻结 LLM 的输入嵌入空间。

paragraphs.en: The Contextual Reader is trained to decode semantic properties of the corresponding final image from contextual representations at arbitrary denoising timesteps. Each training sample therefore consists of a contextual representation, a visual question, and a target answer for the corresponding generated image. We construct this supervision directly from the MM-DiT generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文阅读器经过训练，能够从任意去噪时间步的上下文表示中解码出对应最终图像的语义属性。 因此，每个训练样本都包含一个上下文表示、一个视觉问题以及对应生成图像的目标答案。 我们直接从 MM-DiT 生成过程中构建这种监督机制。

paragraphs.en: To define a consistent set of questions that are meaningful across generations, we focus on images containing a single human subject. We curate 15 questions spanning broad scene properties, such as camera angle and background, as well as finer-grained properties, such as pose, appearance, and object interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 为了定义一套在不同代际中都具有意义的一致性提问，我们专注于包含单个人类主体的图像。 我们精心挑选了 15 个问题，涵盖广泛的场景属性（如相机角度和背景），以及更精细的属性（如姿势、外观和与物体的互动）。

sents.zh: 为了定义一套在不同代际中都具有意义的一致性提问，我们专注于包含单个人类主体的图像。

sents.en: We curate 15 questions spanning broad scene properties, such as camera angle and background, as well as finer-grained properties, such as pose, appearance, and object interaction.
sents.zh: 我们精心挑选了 15 个问题，涵盖广泛的场景属性（如相机角度和背景），以及更精细的属性（如姿势、外观和与物体的互动）。

paragraphs.en: To generate the images, we use a subset of human-centric, single-subject prompts from MS-COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . To encourage the reader to distinguish between different outcomes under the same textual conditioning, we generate five seeds for each prompt. Our dataset comprises 10,000 generations from 2,000 training prompts and 2,500 held-out generations from 500 prompts. For each generated image, an off-the-shelf Vision-Language Model provides answers to the 15 questions, which serve as the target supervision for the reader. For each generated image, we also store the prompt and initial noise used for generation, allowing us to retrieve its contextual representations at arbitrary denoising timesteps during training. The full list of questions and additional dataset construction details are provided in Appendix A.1.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了生成图像，我们使用了来自 MS-COCO（Lin et al., 2014）中一部分以人类为中心、单主体提示词。 为了鼓励读者区分在相同文本条件下产生的不同结果，我们为每个提示词生成了五个种子。 我们的数据集包括来自 2,000 个训练提示词的 10,000 次生成，以及来自 500 个提示词的 2,500 次预留生成。 对于每张生成的图像，一个现成的视觉-语言模型都会对 15 个问题提供答案，这些答案将作为读者的目标监督信号。 对于每张生成的图像，我们还会存储生成时使用的提示词和初始噪声，这样在训练过程中，我们便可以在任意去噪时间步上检索其上下文表示。 问题的完整列表以及数据集构建的更多细节见附录 A.1.3。

paragraphs.en: During reader training, we sample a denoising timestep and a generated image from our dataset, together with its associated questions and answers. Using the stored prompt and initial noise, we reconstruct the noisy latent at the sampled timestep and run the frozen MM-DiT to obtain the contextual representations C ⁡ ( t ) C(t) . The reader then produces answers to the corresponding visual questions, which are supervised against the ground-truth answers using an autoregressive cross-entropy loss. We optimize only the Bottleneck Network, with all other components kept frozen. We train the Reader for 5,000 iterations with a batch size of 256; the validation loss decreases steeply during the first 2,000 iterations, with only modest improvements thereafter. Training details and validation curves are provided in Appendix A.1.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 在读者训练期间，我们从数据集中采样一个去噪时间步和一个生成的图像，并连同其相关的问题和答案一起使用。 利用存储的提示词和初始噪声，我们在采样的时间步上重构带噪声的潜在表示，并运行冻结的 MM-DiT 以获得上下文表示 C(t)。 随后，读者会生成对应视觉问题的答案，并通过自回归交叉熵损失函数与真实答案进行监督对比。 我们仅优化瓶颈网络，其余所有组件均保持冻结状态。 我们以 256 的批量大小对读者进行 5,000 次迭代训练；在最初的 2,000 次迭代中，验证损失迅速下降，之后仅有轻微改善。 训练细节和验证曲线见附录 A.1.4。

paragraphs.en: Having established a mechanism for reading the contextual tokens, we now examine what this representation reveals about the emerging generation. We study this across two pretrained MM-DiTs with different architectures: SD3.5 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , which maintains separate image and text streams while allowing them to exchange information through multimodal attention, and FLUX.2 ( Chefer et al., 2026 ) , which additionally includes single-stream blocks that jointly process the concatenated image and text tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在建立了读取上下文标记的机制之后，我们现在将研究这种表示形式揭示了关于新生成的哪些信息。 我们通过两种具有不同架构的预训练 MM-DiTs 来研究这一问题：SD3.5（Esser 等人，2024），它在保持图像和文本流分离的同时，允许它们通过多模态注意力交换信息；以及 FLUX.2（Chefer 等人，2026），它额外包含了能够联合处理拼接后的图像和文本标记的单流模块。

paragraphs.en: To study how access to the prompt affects what can be decoded from the contextual space, we consider two conditioning settings. In one, the MM-DiT receives the original prompt ( conditional setting ), allowing us to study how the contextual tokens become enriched with image-specific information beyond what the prompt specifies. In the other, the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt ( unconditional setting ), allowing us to examine how much image-specific information can be recovered without access to the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究提示词的可访问性如何影响从上下文空间中解码的内容，我们考虑了两种条件设置。 在一种设置中，MM-DiT 接收原始提示词（有条件设置），这使我们能够研究上下文标记如何获得超出提示词所指定内容的图像特定信息。 在另一种设置中，MM-DiT 接收一个空提示词（无条件设置），这使我们能够检验在没有提示词访问的情况下，可以恢复多少图像特定信息。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows examples from the conditional setting, where two random seeds are generated from the same prompt. Although the textual conditioning is identical, the resulting images resolve underspecified properties differently, and the reader recovers these seed-specific differences from the contextual tokens. For the prompt “A person holding a scarf,” the reader identifies that the background is “green bushes and trees” in one seed, and “a plain white wall” in the other. Turning to the prompt “A person looking into a mirror,” the reader identifies that the person is holding a smartphone in one seed. In the other seed, the person’s hands fall outside the image, and the reader correspondingly answers “Unknown.” These distinctions can often be decoded at an early denoising step, before they are clearly visible in the corresponding visual prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 图3展示了条件设置下的示例，其中两个随机种子由相同的提示生成。 尽管文本条件完全相同，但生成的图像对未明确指定的属性进行了不同的处理，而读者则能从上下文标记中恢复这些与特定种子相关的差异。 对于提示“一个人拿着围巾”，读者识别出其中一个种子的背景是“绿色的灌木和树木”，而另一个种子的背景则是“一面纯白的墙”。 再看提示“一个人照镜子”，读者识别出其中一个种子中的人物正在拿着一部智能手机。 在另一个种子中，人物的手超出了图像范围，因此读者相应地回答“未知”。这些差异通常可以在早期的去噪步骤中被解码，早于它们在对应的视觉预测中清晰显现之前。

paragraphs.en: We next quantify the behavior observed qualitatively in Figures 3 and 4 . At each timestep, we use VLM-as-a-judge ( Lee et al., 2024 ) to compare the reader’s free-form answer with the ground-truth answer and assess its semantic correctness and specificity (see Appendix A.1.5 for details and Appendices B.1.1 and B.1.2 for additional quantitative analyses). The left panel of Figure 5 shows a consistent trend across both architectures. With the input prompt, the contextual representation is informative from the beginning of generation, but its readability continues to increase throughout denoising, reaching its highest value at 80 % 80\% . Since some questions can already be partially answered from the prompt, this continued improvement indicates that the contextual tokens progressively capture attributes left underspecified by the textual conditioning. Readability then shows a small decrease at the final 100 % 100\% timestep, as generation shifts toward refining high-frequency details rather than the semantic properties probed by our questions.

paragraphs.en: With an empty prompt, performance starts substantially lower and rises rapidly as denoising progresses. Notably, it eventually surpasses the conditional reader for FLUX.2 and approaches the conditional performance for SD3.5, showing that the contextual tokens can become highly semantically informative even without direct access to the prompt. These semantics emerge despite the contextual tokens never being explicitly supervised to represent visual content. Because they arise solely under the denoising objective, this suggests that such semantic encoding is useful to the generation process itself. We therefore examine whether the clarity of this implicit representation is also related to the quality of the resulting image.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有提示词的情况下，性能起点明显较低，但随着去噪过程的推进而迅速提升。 值得注意的是，其最终表现超越了 FLUX.2 的条件读取器，并接近 SD3.5 的条件性能，这表明即使无法直接访问提示词，上下文标记也能变得极具语义信息量。 尽管上下文标记从未被明确监督以表示视觉内容，但这些语义特征仍然出现了。 由于这些特征完全是在去噪目标下产生的，这表明此类语义编码对生成过程本身是有用的。 因此，我们进一步探究这种隐式表示的清晰度是否与最终生成图像的质量相关。

paragraphs.en: The middle and right panels of Figure 5 address this relationship. For each prompt, we first rank the five generations according to their reader score averaged across denoising timesteps. We then compare the HPS scores ( Ma et al., 2025 ) of the top- and bottom-ranked generations. The middle panel reports Δ \Delta HPS, defined as the HPS score of the reader top-ranked generation minus that of the bottom-ranked generation. Across architectures and conditioning settings, Δ \Delta HPS is consistently positive, indicating that generations with higher contextual readability tend to receive higher HPS scores. The right panel provides qualitative examples of this relationship: for each prompt, we show the top-ranked generation in green and the bottom-ranked generation in red. The top- and bottom-ranked generations often differ in both visual fidelity and prompt alignment. For example, the bottom-ranked samples contain visible artifacts, such as a malformed toothbrush or tennis racket, and can also misinterpret the prompt, showing a person riding rather than walking behind a horse, or two women sitting on a couch rather than one. This indicates that contextual readability provides a meaningful signal for identifying higher-quality final generations. We therefore turn, in the next section, to explicitly supervising the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens.

paragraphs.en: The previous section reveals that contextual tokens encode rich, global visual-semantic information about the emerging image, and that the clarity of this information is related to the quality of the resulting generation. We therefore seek to make this implicit semantic structure an explicit training signal. Representation alignment provides a natural mechanism for doing so: a pretrained vision encoder provides a target representation, and the diffusion model is trained to align its intermediate visual features with this target ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . These methods primarily align spatial visual representations, and have been shown to benefit from spatially structured teacher representations rather than global semantic ones ( Singh et al., 2025 ) . Since our analysis reveals that contextual tokens encode global visual semantics, we instead use a global semantic teacher to supervise them, providing a complementary form of representation alignment. We therefore introduce Contextual Alignment (CoAl), which aligns contextual tokens with a global semantic representation of the corresponding clean image.
paragraphs.zh: 上一部分表明，上下文标记编码了关于生成图像丰富且全局的视觉-语义信息，而这些信息的清晰度与最终生成结果的质量相关。 因此，我们试图将这种隐式的语义结构转化为显式的训练信号。 表示对齐为此提供了一种自然的机制：预训练的视觉编码器可提供目标表示，而扩散模型则被训练使其中间视觉特征与该目标对齐（Yu et al., 2024；Chefer et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026c）。 这些方法主要对齐空间视觉表示，并且已有研究表明，它们从具有空间结构的教师表示中获益更多，而非全局语义表示（Singh et al., 2025）。 由于我们的分析表明上下文标记编码了全局视觉语义，我们转而使用全局语义教师来监督它们，从而提供一种互补的表示对齐形式。 因此，我们提出了上下文对齐（Contextual Alignment, CoAl），该方法将上下文标记与对应干净图像的全局语义表示进行对齐。

paragraphs.en: Our training process is illustrated in Figure 6 . During training, a frozen semantic encoder maps the clean image to a global teacher embedding, and a lightweight network, the Aligner Network , maps the contextual tokens from a single layer to a predicted embedding. The embedding is then aligned with the teacher via a negative cosine similarity loss. We incorporate this loss into the diffusion objective and optimize the MM-DiT and the Aligner Network jointly; the Aligner Network is used exclusively during training, leaving the MM-DiT’s inference cost unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的训练过程如图 6 所示。 在训练过程中，一个冻结的语义编码器将干净图像映射到全局教师嵌入，而一个轻量级网络——对齐网络（Aligner Network）——则将单个层中的上下文标记映射到预测嵌入。 随后，通过负余弦相似度损失将该嵌入与教师嵌入进行对齐。 我们将此损失纳入扩散目标函数中，并联合优化 MM-DiT 和对齐网络；对齐网络仅在训练阶段使用，因此 MM-DiT 的推理成本保持不变。

sents.zh: 在训练过程中，一个冻结的语义编码器将干净图像映射到全局教师嵌入，而一个轻量级网络——对齐网络（Aligner Network）——则将单个层中的上下文标记映射到预测嵌入。

sents.en: The embedding is then aligned with the teacher via a negative cosine similarity loss.
sents.zh: 随后，通过负余弦相似度损失将该嵌入与教师嵌入进行对齐。

sents.en: We incorporate this loss into the diffusion objective and optimize the MM-DiT and the Aligner Network jointly; the Aligner Network is used exclusively during training, leaving the MM-DiT’s inference cost unchanged.
sents.zh: 我们将此损失纳入扩散目标函数中，并联合优化 MM-DiT 和对齐网络；对齐网络仅在训练阶段使用，因此 MM-DiT 的推理成本保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Seeking a global, semantic, and language-aligned teacher, we use the pooled SigLIP image embedding ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) , which SigLIP trains to align with caption embeddings through a contrastive image-text loss, making it a compact summary of the image. The Aligner Network itself is a small Q-Former, as in the Contextual Reader, but kept even more minimal: a single layer with one learned query. Its limited capacity makes closing the gap to the teacher depend on adaptation of the MM-DiT, rather than on the Aligner Network absorbing the alignment objective. Likewise, by aligning a single, early layer, we encourage the MM-DiT to encode the teacher’s semantics in the contextual tokens early on, leaving the remaining layers free to refine and use them as needed. Both our choice of teacher embedding and our layer selection are confirmed empirically (Appendix B.2.1 ).

paragraphs.en: When training text-to-image diffusion models, the text prompt is occasionally dropped to support classifier-free guidance (CFG) at inference ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) . When the prompt is provided to the model, the alignment objective has an easy shortcut: the contextual tokens can reduce the alignment loss by leveraging information already provided by the prompt, rather than capturing image-specific semantics that the prompt leaves unspecified. On null-condition iterations, however, the tokens are initialized from an empty prompt, closing off this shortcut, meaning any alignment must instead be drawn through interaction between the contextual and image tokens. We therefore upweight the alignment loss specifically on null-condition iterations, encouraging a flow of semantic information from the image tokens into the contextual tokens. In practice, we apply this upweighting only in the later stages of full model training, or throughout fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练文本到图像的扩散模型时，有时会省略文本提示，以便在推理阶段支持无分类器引导（CFG）（Ho 和 Salimans，2022）。 当向模型提供提示时，对齐目标存在一个简单的捷径：上下文标记可以利用提示中已提供的信息来减少对齐损失，而不是捕捉提示未明确说明的图像特定语义。 然而，在空条件迭代中，这些标记是从空提示初始化的，从而切断了这一捷径，这意味着任何对齐都必须通过上下文标记与图像标记之间的相互作用来实现。 因此，我们专门在空条件迭代中提高对齐损失的权重，以鼓励语义信息从图像标记流向上下文标记。 在实践中，我们仅在完整模型训练的后期阶段或整个微调过程中应用这种权重提升。

paragraphs.en: Training a generator from random initialization is the standard protocol for evaluating alignment methods, but for many practitioners the realistic use case is to adapt a pretrained generator to a dataset that reflects what they want to generate. We therefore evaluate CoAl in two complementary regimes. First, we train a dual-stream MM-DiT from random initialization on MS-COCO 2014 ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . Second, we fine-tune SD3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , a pretrained dual-stream MM-DiT, on the curated subset of Fine-T2I ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , a dataset specifically designed for T2I fine-tuning that pairs professional photographs with long, detailed prompts. This tests whether contextual supervision remains effective after extensive pretraining, when adapting to a new data distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 从随机初始化开始训练生成器是评估对齐方法的标准流程，但许多实践者更现实的使用场景是，将预训练的生成器适配到能反映他们期望生成内容的数据集上。 因此，我们在两种互补的模式下对 CoAl 进行了评估。 首先，我们在 MS-COCO 2014（Lin et al., 2014）上从随机初始化开始训练一个双流 MM-DiT。 其次，我们在 Fine-T2I（Ma et al., 2026）的精选子集上微调了 SD3（Esser et al., 2024），这是一个预训练的双流 MM-DiT；Fine-T2I 是一个专为 T2I 微调设计的数据集，它将专业照片与长而详细的提示词配对。 这检验了在广泛预训练之后，当适配新的数据分布时，上下文监督是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: We compare against REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and its later variants, HASTE ( Wang et al., 2026c ) and SRA ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . For full model training, we test whether CoAl complements these visual alignment methods, comparing each objective with and without CoAl. For fine-tuning, however, REPA and its variants offer no meaningful gains over the vanilla denoising objective, so we instead combine CoAl with vanilla flow matching, including REPA, HASTE, and SRA for completeness. In the main manuscript, we report FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , HPS ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) Precision and Recall ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2019 ) . For fine-tuning, we omit CLIP and HPS. These metrics are trained on broad, general-purpose distributions of images, captions, and preferences, so they capture what users prefer on average, which need not coincide with the characteristics of a particular fine-tuning dataset. Indeed, the ground-truth photographs score below the base model on CLIP and HPS, and therefore comparing along these axes is ill-posed. We instead evaluate how well the generated images fit and cover the target distribution, using FID, KID, and DINOv2 Precision and Recall. Our full result tables, including additional metrics and baselines, are provided in Appendix B.2.2 .

paragraphs.en: We have presented a framework for reading the internal perceptual representations of generative models through natural language. More broadly, our work suggests that a generative model knows surprisingly early what it is going to generate. Semantic details of the final image are already present internally before they become perceptually apparent in the emerging image. Even more strikingly, this remains true without the text prompt: the model develops a rich semantic picture of the emerging image through the generation process itself. This observation also has a useful consequence: generations in which this internal representation is clearer tend to result in better images. This suggests that the representation is not only something we can read, but also something worth strengthening. Our Contextual Alignment does exactly this, leading to improved generations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种通过自然语言读取生成模型内部感知表示的框架。 更广泛地说，我们的工作表明，生成模型会出人意料地早知道自己将要生成什么。 最终图像的语义细节在它们于生成的图像中变得可感知之前，就已经存在于模型内部了。 更令人惊讶的是，即使没有文本提示，这一结论依然成立：模型通过生成过程本身，就形成了对正在生成的图像的丰富语义图像。 这一观察还有一个有用的推论：内部表示越清晰的生成过程，往往能产生更好的图像。 这表明这种表示不仅是我们可以读取的东西，也是值得强化的东西。 我们的“上下文对齐”方法正是这样做的，从而带来了更优质的生成结果。

sents.zh: 这表明这种表示不仅是我们可以读取的东西，也是值得强化的东西。

sents.en: Our Contextual Alignment does exactly this, leading to improved generations.
sents.zh: 我们的“上下文对齐”方法正是这样做的，从而带来了更优质的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: Our findings also highlight how much remains to be understood about the internal process of generative models. We can now read some of the semantic information that emerges during generation, but how these internal representations form, evolve, and ultimately shape the generated image remains largely unexplored. The fact that meaningful information appears so early, even before it becomes perceptually apparent, raises many new questions about the generation process itself. We believe that further studying these internal representations can deepen our understanding of generative models and reveal new opportunities for controlling and improving them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果还凸显了生成模型内部过程仍有大量未知之处。 我们现在能够读取生成过程中出现的部分语义信息，但这些内部表示如何形成、演变并最终塑造生成的图像，在很大程度上仍属未解之谜。 有意义的信息在感知上尚未显现之前就已出现这一事实，为生成过程本身带来了许多新的问题。 我们相信，进一步研究这些内部表示能够加深我们对生成模型的理解，并揭示控制与改进它们的新机遇。

paragraphs.en: We extract contextual representations from the attention operator of the frozen MM-DiT at the selected diffusion timestep. Specifically, we extract the output of the attention operator before the subsequent block-specific attention gate, residual addition, normalization, or MLP update. We retain only the contextual/text positions and exclude image-token positions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在选定的扩散时间步上，从冻结的 MM-DiT 的注意力算子中提取上下文表示。 具体来说，我们在后续的块特定注意力门、残差相加、归一化或 MLP 更新之前，提取注意力算子的输出。 我们仅保留上下文/文本位置，并排除图像标记位置。

sents.en: We extract contextual representations from the attention operator of the frozen MM-DiT at the selected diffusion timestep.
sents.zh: 我们在选定的扩散时间步上，从冻结的 MM-DiT 的注意力算子中提取上下文表示。

sents.en: Specifically, we extract the output of the attention operator before the subsequent block-specific attention gate, residual addition, normalization, or MLP update.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们在后续的块特定注意力门、残差相加、归一化或 MLP 更新之前，提取注意力算子的输出。

sents.en: We retain only the contextual/text positions and exclude image-token positions.
sents.zh: 我们仅保留上下文/文本位置，并排除图像标记位置。

paragraphs.en: For SD3.5, we capture the text-side output of joint attention from all transformer blocks. For FLUX.2, we capture the text-side output from all dual-stream blocks and the text positions from all single-stream blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 SD3.5，我们捕获所有 Transformer 块中联合注意力的文本侧输出。 对于 FLUX.2，我们捕获所有双流块的文本侧输出以及所有单流块的文本位置。

sents.en: For SD3.5, we capture the text-side output of joint attention from all transformer blocks.
sents.zh: 对于 SD3.5，我们捕获所有 Transformer 块中联合注意力的文本侧输出。

sents.en: For FLUX.2, we capture the text-side output from all dual-stream blocks and the text positions from all single-stream blocks.
sents.zh: 对于 FLUX.2，我们捕获所有双流块的文本侧输出以及所有单流块的文本位置。

paragraphs.en: For the conditional reader, we use the contextual representations produced by the positive-prompt branch. For the unconditional reader, we use the model’s empty-prompt setting. No image tokens are supplied to the reader.
paragraphs.zh: 对于条件阅读器，我们使用正向提示分支生成的上下文表示。 对于无条件阅读器，我们使用模型的空提示设置。 不会向阅读器提供任何图像标记。

sents.en: For the conditional reader, we use the contextual representations produced by the positive-prompt branch.
sents.zh: 对于条件阅读器，我们使用正向提示分支生成的上下文表示。

sents.en: For the unconditional reader, we use the model’s empty-prompt setting.
sents.zh: 对于无条件阅读器，我们使用模型的空提示设置。

sents.en: No image tokens are supplied to the reader.
sents.zh: 不会向阅读器提供任何图像标记。

paragraphs.en: Because the reader aggregates contextual representations from multiple MM-DiT layers, we add a learned layer embedding to the contextual tokens from each layer before concatenating them. We also provide the denoising timestep to the reader. The continuous noise level σ \sigma is encoded using a 256-dimensional sinusoidal embedding followed by an MLP with dimensions 256 → 256 → D 256\rightarrow 256\rightarrow D and SiLU activation, where D D is the hidden dimension of the corresponding diffusion backbone. The resulting timestep embedding is added to every contextual token. We do not average or otherwise mix the representations across layers before the Q-Former; all layer-token pairs remain independently accessible.
paragraphs.zh: 由于阅读器会从多个 MM-DiT 层聚合上下文表示，因此我们在将各层的上下文标记连接之前，会为其添加一个可学习的层嵌入。 我们还将去噪时间步信息提供给阅读器。 连续噪声水平 σ \sigma 通过一个 256 维的正弦嵌入进行编码，随后是一个维度为 256 → 256 → D 的 MLP 和 SiLU 激活函数，其中 D D 是对应扩散主干网络的隐藏维度。 最终得到的时间步嵌入会被添加到每个上下文标记中。 在 Q-Former 之前，我们不会对不同层的表示进行平均或任何形式的混合；所有层与标记的组合都保持独立可访问。

sents.en: Because the reader aggregates contextual representations from multiple MM-DiT layers, we add a learned layer embedding to the contextual tokens from each layer before concatenating them.
sents.zh: 由于阅读器会从多个 MM-DiT 层聚合上下文表示，因此我们在将各层的上下文标记连接之前，会为其添加一个可学习的层嵌入。

sents.en: We also provide the denoising timestep to the reader.
sents.zh: 我们还将去噪时间步信息提供给阅读器。

sents.en: The continuous noise level σ \sigma is encoded using a 256-dimensional sinusoidal embedding followed by an MLP with dimensions 256 → 256 → D 256\rightarrow 256\rightarrow D and SiLU activation, where D D is the hidden dimension of the corresponding diffusion backbone.
sents.zh: 连续噪声水平 σ \sigma 通过一个 256 维的正弦嵌入进行编码，随后是一个维度为 256 → 256 → D 的 MLP 和 SiLU 激活函数，其中 D D 是对应扩散主干网络的隐藏维度。

sents.en: The resulting timestep embedding is added to every contextual token.
sents.zh: 最终得到的时间步嵌入会被添加到每个上下文标记中。

sents.en: We do not average or otherwise mix the representations across layers before the Q-Former; all layer-token pairs remain independently accessible.
sents.zh: 在 Q-Former 之前，我们不会对不同层的表示进行平均或任何形式的混合；所有层与标记的组合都保持独立可访问。

paragraphs.en: The Bottleneck Network is a two-block, eight-head Q-Former with 16 learned queries. Its hidden dimension matches that of the corresponding diffusion backbone. Each Q-Former block uses a cross-first ordering. The learned queries first attend to all contextual tokens through pre-normalized cross-attention, followed by a residual connection. This is followed by pre-normalized self-attention among the queries and a residual connection, and then a pre-normalized feed-forward network with dimensions D → 2048 → D D\rightarrow 2048\rightarrow D , GELU activation, and a residual connection. A final layer normalization is applied after the second block. No dropout is used.
paragraphs.zh: 瓶颈网络是一个包含两个块、八个头的 Q-Former，具有 16 个可学习的查询。 其隐藏维度与对应的扩散主干网络的隐藏维度相匹配。 每个 Q-Former 块都采用交叉优先排序。 可学习的查询首先通过预归一化的交叉注意力关注所有上下文标记，随后接有一个残差连接。 接下来是查询之间的预归一化自注意力以及一个残差连接，然后是维度为 D → 2048 → D 的预归一化前馈网络，包含 GELU 激活函数和一个残差连接。 在第二个块之后应用了最终的层归一化。未使用任何 dropout。

sents.en: The Bottleneck Network is a two-block, eight-head Q-Former with 16 learned queries.
sents.zh: 瓶颈网络是一个包含两个块、八个头的 Q-Former，具有 16 个可学习的查询。

sents.en: Its hidden dimension matches that of the corresponding diffusion backbone.
sents.zh: 其隐藏维度与对应的扩散主干网络的隐藏维度相匹配。

sents.en: Each Q-Former block uses a cross-first ordering.
sents.zh: 每个 Q-Former 块都采用交叉优先排序。

sents.en: The learned queries first attend to all contextual tokens through pre-normalized cross-attention, followed by a residual connection.
sents.zh: 可学习的查询首先通过预归一化的交叉注意力关注所有上下文标记，随后接有一个残差连接。

sents.en: This is followed by pre-normalized self-attention among the queries and a residual connection, and then a pre-normalized feed-forward network with dimensions D → 2048 → D D\rightarrow 2048\rightarrow D , GELU activation, and a residual connection.
sents.zh: 接下来是查询之间的预归一化自注意力以及一个残差连接，然后是维度为 D → 2048 → D 的预归一化前馈网络，包含 GELU 激活函数和一个残差连接。

sents.en: A final layer normalization is applied after the second block. No dropout is used.
sents.zh: 在第二个块之后应用了最终的层归一化。未使用任何 dropout。

paragraphs.en: The Q-Former outputs are mapped individually into the input embedding space of the frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) language model using a learned affine projection. Each projected token is L2-normalized and rescaled to the mean norm of the LLM’s vocabulary embeddings, excluding the padding token.
paragraphs.zh: 通过一个经过学习的仿射投影，将 Q-Former 的输出分别映射到冻结的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen 等，2025）语言模型的输入嵌入空间中。 每个投影后的词元都经过 L2 归一化，并重新缩放到大型语言模型词汇表嵌入的平均范数水平，其中不包含填充词元。

sents.en: The Q-Former outputs are mapped individually into the input embedding space of the frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) language model using a learned affine projection.
sents.zh: 通过一个经过学习的仿射投影，将 Q-Former 的输出分别映射到冻结的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen 等，2025）语言模型的输入嵌入空间中。

sents.en: Each projected token is L2-normalized and rescaled to the mean norm of the LLM’s vocabulary embeddings, excluding the padding token.
sents.zh: 每个投影后的词元都经过 L2 归一化，并重新缩放到大型语言模型词汇表嵌入的平均范数水平，其中不包含填充词元。

paragraphs.en: The resulting Contextual Descriptor is provided to the LLM as a sequence of 16 continuous prefix embeddings, followed by the textual question and its answer-format instruction. The original generation prompt is not provided to the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的上下文描述符以连续的前缀嵌入序列形式提供给 LLM，该序列包含 16 个嵌入，随后是文本问题及其答案格式说明。 原始生成提示不会提供给 LLM。

sents.en: The resulting Contextual Descriptor is provided to the LLM as a sequence of 16 continuous prefix embeddings, followed by the textual question and its answer-format instruction.
sents.zh: 生成的上下文描述符以连续的前缀嵌入序列形式提供给 LLM，该序列包含 16 个嵌入，随后是文本问题及其答案格式说明。

sents.en: The original generation prompt is not provided to the LLM.
sents.zh: 原始生成提示不会提供给 LLM。

paragraphs.en: During teacher-forced training, the target consists of the ground-truth answer and the tokenizer EOS token. The cross-entropy loss is computed only over answer tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在教师强制训练期间，目标由真实答案和分词器的 EOS 标记组成。 交叉熵损失仅针对答案标记进行计算。

sents.en: During teacher-forced training, the target consists of the ground-truth answer and the tokenizer EOS token.
sents.zh: 在教师强制训练期间，目标由真实答案和分词器的 EOS 标记组成。

sents.en: The cross-entropy loss is computed only over answer tokens.
sents.zh: 交叉熵损失仅针对答案标记进行计算。

paragraphs.en: We construct the dataset for training and evaluating the Contextual Reader from the 2014 MS-COCO training split. We first restrict the source images to those containing exactly one non-crowd person instance according to the COCO instance annotations. We then filter the associated captions based on their textual content: each caption is classified by the text-only model Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) as describing either zero, one, multiple, or an ambiguous number of real people. We retain captions classified as describing exactly one real person without ambiguity. This procedure produces 62,069 eligible captions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 2014 年 MS-COCO 训练数据集中构建用于训练和评估“情境阅读者”的数据集。 首先，根据 COCO 实例标注，我们将源图像限制为仅包含一个非人群个体实例的图像。 接着，我们基于文本内容对相关的图像描述进行筛选：每个图像描述都由纯文本模型 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen 等，2025）分类为描述零个、一个、多个或数量不明确的人。 我们保留被分类为明确描述恰好一个真实人的图像描述。 该流程共产生 62,069 条符合条件的图像描述。

sents.en: We construct the dataset for training and evaluating the Contextual Reader from the 2014 MS-COCO training split.
sents.zh: 我们从 2014 年 MS-COCO 训练数据集中构建用于训练和评估“情境阅读者”的数据集。

sents.en: We first restrict the source images to those containing exactly one non-crowd person instance according to the COCO instance annotations.
sents.zh: 首先，根据 COCO 实例标注，我们将源图像限制为仅包含一个非人群个体实例的图像。

sents.en: We then filter the associated captions based on their textual content: each caption is classified by the text-only model Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) as describing either zero, one, multiple, or an ambiguous number of real people.
sents.zh: 接着，我们基于文本内容对相关的图像描述进行筛选：每个图像描述都由纯文本模型 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen 等，2025）分类为描述零个、一个、多个或数量不明确的人。

sents.en: We retain captions classified as describing exactly one real person without ambiguity.
sents.zh: 我们保留被分类为明确描述恰好一个真实人的图像描述。

sents.en: This procedure produces 62,069 eligible captions.
sents.zh: 该流程共产生 62,069 条符合条件的图像描述。

paragraphs.en: From these captions, we select 2,500 prompts from distinct COCO source images using deterministic stratified sampling. We first select 500 prompts for the held-out set and then select 2,000 prompts from the remaining images, ensuring no source-image overlap between the two sets. Each prompt is rendered with five randomly assigned seeds, such that no seed is shared between prompts. This results in 10,000 training generations and 2,500 held-out generations per diffusion backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从这些说明文字中，通过确定性分层抽样方法，从不同的 COCO 源图像中选出 2,500 个提示。 我们首先为预留集选出 500 个提示，然后从剩余的图像中再选出 2,000 个提示，确保两个集合之间没有源图像的重叠。 每个提示都使用五个随机分配的种子进行生成，从而确保不同提示之间不会共享任何种子。 这样，每个扩散模型主干都会产生 10,000 次训练生成和 2,500 次预留集生成。

sents.en: From these captions, we select 2,500 prompts from distinct COCO source images using deterministic stratified sampling.
sents.zh: 我们从这些说明文字中，通过确定性分层抽样方法，从不同的 COCO 源图像中选出 2,500 个提示。

sents.en: We first select 500 prompts for the held-out set and then select 2,000 prompts from the remaining images, ensuring no source-image overlap between the two sets.
sents.zh: 我们首先为预留集选出 500 个提示，然后从剩余的图像中再选出 2,000 个提示，确保两个集合之间没有源图像的重叠。

sents.en: Each prompt is rendered with five randomly assigned seeds, such that no seed is shared between prompts.
sents.zh: 每个提示都使用五个随机分配的种子进行生成，从而确保不同提示之间不会共享任何种子。

sents.en: This results in 10,000 training generations and 2,500 held-out generations per diffusion backbone.
sents.zh: 这样，每个扩散模型主干都会产生 10,000 次训练生成和 2,500 次预留集生成。

paragraphs.en: We generate images at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. SD3.5 uses 28 FlowMatch Euler denoising steps and guidance scale 7.0, while FLUX.2 uses 50 FlowMatch Euler steps and guidance scale 4.0. The same prompt-to-seed mapping is used for both backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 1024 × 1024 的分辨率生成图像。 SD3.5 使用 28 步 FlowMatch Euler 去噪和引导系数 7.0，而 FLUX.2 则使用 50 步 FlowMatch Euler 和引导系数 4.0。 两种基础模型均使用相同的提示词到种子的映射关系。

sents.en: We generate images at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution.
sents.zh: 我们以 1024 × 1024 的分辨率生成图像。

sents.en: SD3.5 uses 28 FlowMatch Euler denoising steps and guidance scale 7.0, while FLUX.2 uses 50 FlowMatch Euler steps and guidance scale 4.0.
sents.zh: SD3.5 使用 28 步 FlowMatch Euler 去噪和引导系数 7.0，而 FLUX.2 则使用 50 步 FlowMatch Euler 和引导系数 4.0。

sents.en: The same prompt-to-seed mapping is used for both backbones.
sents.zh: 两种基础模型均使用相同的提示词到种子的映射关系。

paragraphs.en: We manually curate 15 visual questions designed to span diverse semantic aspects of human-centric images, including appearance, pose, activity, spatial configuration, and scene properties. The complete set of questions is shown in Figure 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们手动整理了 15 个视觉问题，这些问题旨在涵盖以人类为中心图像的多种语义方面，包括外观、姿态、活动、空间配置和场景属性。 完整的问题集如图 8 所示。

sents.en: We manually curate 15 visual questions designed to span diverse semantic aspects of human-centric images, including appearance, pose, activity, spatial configuration, and scene properties.
sents.zh: 我们手动整理了 15 个视觉问题，这些问题旨在涵盖以人类为中心图像的多种语义方面，包括外观、姿态、活动、空间配置和场景属性。

sents.en: The complete set of questions is shown in Figure 8 .
sents.zh: 完整的问题集如图 8 所示。

paragraphs.en: For each generated image, we obtain an answer to each question using InternVL3-8B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . The teacher receives only the generated image and the visual question, without access to the original generation prompt, and is instructed to answer using visible image evidence. Answers are generated independently using deterministic decoding. We automatically validate the generated responses and retry invalid answers up to two times, replacing answers that remain invalid with “unknown.”
paragraphs.zh: 对于每张生成的图像，我们使用 InternVL3-8B（Zhu 等人，2025）来获取每个问题的答案。 教师仅能获取生成的图像和视觉问题，无法访问原始生成提示，并被要求根据图像中的可见证据进行回答。 答案通过确定性解码独立生成。 我们自动验证生成的回答，对无效答案最多重试两次，若仍无效则替换为“未知”。

sents.en: For each generated image, we obtain an answer to each question using InternVL3-8B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 对于每张生成的图像，我们使用 InternVL3-8B（Zhu 等人，2025）来获取每个问题的答案。

sents.en: The teacher receives only the generated image and the visual question, without access to the original generation prompt, and is instructed to answer using visible image evidence.
sents.zh: 教师仅能获取生成的图像和视觉问题，无法访问原始生成提示，并被要求根据图像中的可见证据进行回答。

sents.en: Answers are generated independently using deterministic decoding.
sents.zh: 答案通过确定性解码独立生成。

sents.en: We automatically validate the generated responses and retry invalid answers up to two times, replacing answers that remain invalid with “unknown.”
sents.zh: 我们自动验证生成的回答，对无效答案最多重试两次，若仍无效则替换为“未知”。

paragraphs.en: We train a separate reader for each diffusion backbone and conditioning setting. The diffusion backbone, text encoders, VAE, and LLM remain frozen throughout training. Only the Q-Former and the projection layer are optimized.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每种扩散主干网络和条件设置单独训练一个读取器。 在整个训练过程中，扩散主干网络、文本编码器、VAE 和 LLM 均保持冻结状态。 仅对 Q-Former 和投影层进行优化。

sents.en: We train a separate reader for each diffusion backbone and conditioning setting.
sents.zh: 我们为每种扩散主干网络和条件设置单独训练一个读取器。

sents.en: The diffusion backbone, text encoders, VAE, and LLM remain frozen throughout training.
sents.zh: 在整个训练过程中，扩散主干网络、文本编码器、VAE 和 LLM 均保持冻结状态。

sents.en: Only the Q-Former and the projection layer are optimized.
sents.zh: 仅对 Q-Former 和投影层进行优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the reader’s predictions using a VLM-as-a-judge. paragraphs.en: The judge assigns an integer score from 1 to 5 based on semantic correctness, completeness, and consistency with the image. paragraphs.en: Across architectures, contextual features are extracted in the same manner as in the Contextual Reader (Appendix A.1.1 ): tokens from the contextual indices are pooled immediately after the shared attention block. paragraphs.en: The Aligner network is made up of a Q-Former followed by a small MLP. The Q-Former is 24 24 head single-layer, single-query Q-Former which attends to the contextual features via pre-normalized cross-attention between the learnable query and the features. The MLP is made up of two linear layers and SiLU activation such that the dimension of the vector produced by the Q-Former is D → 1024 → d y D\rightarrow 1024\rightarrow d_{y} . With D D being the hidden dimension of the contextual tokens ( 768 768 in the MM-DiT used in the full model training setting, 1536 1536 in the SD3-Medium model used in the fine-tune setting). As explained in the main paper, the Aligner network, along with the MM-DiT, are optimized via a negative cosine similarity loss between the Aligner Network output and the teacher embedding.

paragraphs.en: In the full model training setting the MM-DiT architecture we train is based on the Stable Diffusion 3 model ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , but is trained entirely from scratch (no pretrained weights) at a reduced scale: 24 24 transformer layers, matching SD3’s own depth, with a hidden dimension of 768 768 and 24 24 attention heads (32-dimensional per head), compared to SD3-Medium’s 1536 1536 -dimensional hidden size at the same head count (64-dimensional per head). Training data is MS-COCO 2014 ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , downloaded from this source , using the official train2014 / val2014 split ( 82,783 / 40,504 82{,}783/40{,}504 images, each with ∼ \sim 5 captions), at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. We use the AdamW optimizer with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , no weight decay, and ϵ = 1 × 10 − 8 \epsilon=1\times 10^{-8} , with a global batch size of 256 256 . We maintain an exponential moving average (EMA) of the model weights with decay 0.9999 0.9999 , initialized as an exact copy of the model at step 0, and report all results using the EMA weights. We train for 150,000 150{,}000 iterations using fp16 mixed precision. Using 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs training takes approximately 12.5 12.5 hours.

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 shows the resulting readability scores for both diffusion backbones. To this end, we train a Prompt Reader using the same LLM and reader architecture as the Contextual Reader, but provide it only with the input prompt rather than contextual tokens. The Prompt Reader is trained with the same visual questions and target answers as the Contextual Reader.

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 compares the resulting readability scores for both diffusion backbones and conditioning settings. The Prompt Reader achieves constant readability throughout denoising, as expected since its input prompt remains unchanged. In contrast, the conditional Contextual Reader achieves higher readability than the Prompt Reader throughout denoising, with the largest gap between 20 % 20\% and 80 % 80\% . paragraphs.en: To validate our design choices, we ablate the semantic teacher, the contextual layer at which alignment is applied, and the null-condition weighting scheme, in both the full model training and fine-tuning settings (Table 2 ). Across both settings, CoAl is fairly robust to the choice of teacher, though SigLIP consistently edges out CLIP, DINOv2, and Qwen3-VL-2B. Aligning earlier contextual layers also consistently outperforms aligning later ones, likely because doing so gives more of the network the opportunity to make use of the well-aligned representation as it propagates forward. Finally, null-condition weighting proves especially important in the fine-tuning setting: since a pre-trained model already aligns reasonably well with the semantic teacher whenever the prompt is present, upweighting the loss contributes most on the text-dropped iterations, where that shortcut disappears.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证我们的设计选择，我们在完整模型训练和微调两种设置中，分别对语义教师、应用对齐的上下文层以及空条件加权方案进行了消融分析（表2）。 在这两种设置中，CoAl 对教师模型的选择表现出相当强的鲁棒性，尽管 SigLIP 始终略优于 CLIP、DINOv2 和 Qwen3-VL-2B。 对齐更早的上下文层也始终优于对齐更晚的上下文层，这可能是因为这样做能让网络中更多部分有机会利用在向前传播过程中已良好对齐的表示。 最后，空条件加权在微调设置中显得尤为重要：由于预训练模型在提示存在时已经能与语义教师实现相当良好的对齐，因此提升损失权重主要在文本被移除的迭代中发挥作用，此时这种捷径会消失。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the results in the main paper, we provide an extended quantitative comparison for both the full model training and fine-tuning settings (Tables 3 and 4 ), reporting VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) and KID ( Bińkowski et al., 2018 ) alongside the metrics used in the main paper. KID can be more informative than FID on smaller evaluation sets, which is relevant here since the Fine-T2I validation set contains only 5k images. We also add REG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) as an additional baseline in both settings. Similar to CoAl, it supervises a global semantic representation of the image rather than local, patch-level structure, which made it a natural point of comparison. However, it is designed for class-conditional architectures with no text branch, and it does not seem to translate well to MM-DiT, which already carries this kind of information through a fully functional contextual branch. Its FID and KID both come out worse than plain diffusion training. We therefore do not include it in the main manuscript or test it in combination with CoAl. For fine-tuning, we also report Reference and Base Model rows, where Reference denotes the real Fine-T2I validation images and Base Model is the pretrained SD3-Medium checkpoint before fine-tuning. For every configuration combined with CoAl, we report both how it compares to its own non-CoAl counterpart, colored green where it improves and red where it regresses, with the percent change alongside it, and how it ranks against every other configuration in the table, with bold/underline marking the best/second-best per column.

paragraphs.en: One might argue that our null-condition weighting scheme simply shifts the effective classifier-free guidance scale reached during training, and that evaluating at a different CFG value could reveal different behavior. To test this, we sweep CFG scale from 1 to 9 for Vanilla, REPA, HASTE, and Vanilla + CoAl on the Fine-T2I curated benchmark (Figure 19 ). CoAl is consistently the strongest of the four across the entire sweep. CFG = 2 =2 gives the best FID and KID for every method, ourselves included. We nonetheless use CFG = 7 =7 for all evaluations and generations elsewhere in the paper, since it offers a better balance between prompt adherence and distributional fidelity. Recent work ties image quality under classifier-free guidance to how closely the conditional and unconditional predictions agree with each other over the course of sampling: as the distance between them grows, the guidance direction takes large, sharp turns that can push generation off the data manifold ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Yehezkel et al., 2025 ) . CoAl handles large CFG values noticeably better than the other methods, which could suggest that its conditional and unconditional predictions agree with each other more closely. This is indeed what our null-condition weighting is designed to encourage: by encouraging the contextual branch to draw on information from the image tokens when the prompt is omitted, we in turn encourage similarity between the null and conditioned predictions, assuming the image is aligned with the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 有人可能会认为，我们的空条件加权方案只是改变了训练期间达到的有效无分类器引导尺度，而在不同的 CFG 值上进行评估可能会揭示不同的行为。 为了验证这一点，我们在 Fine-T2I 精选基准数据集上对 Vanilla、REPA、HASTE 以及 Vanilla + CoAl 的 CFG 尺度从 1 到 9 进行了全面扫描（图 19）。 在整个扫描过程中，CoAl 始终优于其他三种方法。 对于所有方法（包括我们自己的方法），CFG = 2 =2 都能获得最佳的 FID 和 KID。 尽管如此，在本文其余部分的评估和生成中，我们仍使用 CFG = 7 =7，因为它能在提示遵循性与分布保真性之间取得更好的平衡。 近期的研究将无分类器引导下的图像质量与采样过程中条件预测和无条件预测之间的吻合程度联系起来：随着两者之间的距离增大，引导方向会发生剧烈而突兀的转向，从而可能使生成结果偏离数据流形（Wang et al., 2026a; Yehezkel et al., 2025）。 CoAl 在处理较大的 CFG 值时明显优于其他方法，这可能表明其条件预测和无条件预测之间的吻合度更高。 这正是我们的空条件加权机制所旨在促进的：通过鼓励上下文分支在提示被省略时利用图像标记中的信息，我们反过来促进了空条件预测与有條件预测之间的相似性，前提是图像与提示保持一致。
